gold_description: Properties. Requirements 3.2.9-3.2.12 are not designed. A driver should be specifiied with different properties but this is not implemented. This fault can be found in many places in the design.
Atomatic reject. There is not "automatic reject as in requirement 3.1.3.
Allocate car. Requirement 3.2.4 and the design of allocate_car (3.3.1 i STLDD) do not correspind.
ACK is missing. Acknoledgement (ACK) is missing when text messages are sent. The system does not confirm that text messages are received and OK. Requirment 3.2.5.
Not Available. The signla "Not_Avail" is sent in wrong occasion. According to the requirements, a taxi driver is available already when an order has been accepted.
LogOut is missing. The signal "Log_out" is missing and a taxi driver cannot log out of the system.
Reset Alarm. A taxi driver can reset the alarm, which is not allowed according to the requirements.
Log out. The operator cannot log out of the system.
Login Rejected is missing. The signal "Login_rejected" is missing. No validation of drivers occurs.
Logged in parameters. The signal "Logged In" misses parameters.
Login in parameters. The signal ???"Login"??? misses a parameter.
Confirm Voice. The signal "Confirm_Voice" is missing.
Manual Dispatch. A signal to confirm a manual dispatch is missing in section 3.3.2.  Further, a signal cannot be marked for manual dispatch.
